domains.query: Read-only graph traversal & dataflow analysis (search, inspect, trace, entrypoints, sources, sinks, guards, sanitizers, roles, stats, tree)
domains.module: Manage MACRO-architecture logical views (group files/dirs, analyze deps)
domains.tag: Apply MICRO-level semantic/state tags to AST nodes. Layer formats: L1 ONTOLOGY:{NAMESPACE}:{NAME}, L2 SEMANTIC:{NAMESPACE}:{NAME}, L3 STATE:{NAME|CUSTOM:{NAME}}. L1 write policy: ENTRY_POINT/SOURCE/SINK are system-only; GUARD/SANITIZER/ROLE are collaborative with justification. See docs/TAG_SYSTEM.md
domains.note: Attach audit insight notes to nodes. Categories: ARCHITECTURE, DATA_FLOW, CONTROL_FLOW, VULNERABILITY, COORDINATION, SECURITY_BOUNDARY. See docs/NOTE_SYSTEM.md
domains.repair: Manually patch broken CALL edges to fix dataflow traces
domains.rules: Manage project-specific analysis rules (define custom sources, sinks, safe functions)
domains.knowledge: Project typed knowledge artifacts (NOTE, TAG) onto CPG nodes via semantic matching
domains.federation: Cross-graph federation coordination — register graphs, link boundaries, query virtual neighbors
domains.build: Build CPG graph from source code or Joern CSV export
